# Unhoard

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) Windows app that shows where your disk space went and helps you get it back safely: a living cell map of the drive, an explanation and risk tier for every big item, a 30-day quarantine with restore, OneDrive awareness without downloads, photo review, and a companion character. Tauri 2, Rust core, React/TypeScript UI. English and Dutch.

Start with AGENTS.md for the working rules and docs/README.md for the map of all docs.

## Product

- [Vision](docs/01-vision.md): the problem, the promise and the principles behind Unhoard.
- [Target users](docs/02-target-users.md): the ideal user profile and four personas.
- [Market landscape](docs/03-market-landscape.md): existing open-source, paid and built-in tools, with a feature matrix.
- [Competitive advantage](docs/04-competitive-advantage.md): where Unhoard is better, where it is not, and why.
- [MVP scope](docs/05-mvp-scope.md): features F1–F11, safety invariants S1–S10, acceptance criteria and the tests that come first.
- [Roadmap](docs/06-roadmap.md): Now, Next and Later, without version numbers.

## Features

- [Storage map](docs/10-storage-map.md): the power-diagram cell map, the treemap switch, colours, zoom and hidden space.
- [Cleanup and safety](docs/11-cleanup-safety.md): risk tiers, protected paths, the per-drive quarantine, manifests, restore and the 30-day purge.
- [Known locations](docs/12-known-locations.md): the TOML rule library that explains big items, its precedence and the MVP entries.
- [Cloud storage](docs/13-cloud-storage.md): OneDrive placeholders, free up space, the hydration guard and the cloud quarantine.
- [Photo review](docs/14-photo-review.md): source patterns, duplicate and burst groups, best shot and the review grid, without downloads.
- [Companion](docs/15-companion.md): the guide character, bubble rules, triggers and the AI roadmap.
- [Optimise](docs/16-optimise.md): the honest check-up in Next, its six groups and the background-insight limits.

- [Privacy](docs/30-privacy.md): no telemetry, no network in the MVP, and what is stored locally.
